record.title: VIC-I sound advances on the machine clock and batches PCM without hot-path allocation
record.body: Mos6561 owns one machine-agnostic Vic20Sound engine. System-clock advancement produces deterministic PCM16 mono and dispatches 256-sample batches without per-store allocation. Native parity is scoped to the covered silence and tone inputs.
